operations.name: helpdesk.tickets.list
operations.summary: The tickets of status (open, pending, solved, closed; unsolved, the default, for open and pending; all), up to limit (default 100, at most 1000): each {id, subject, description, status, requester, tags, created_at, updated_at}, the requester by identifier only; with_comments adds comments as helpdesk.tickets.read gives them. complete says whether every ticket was answered.

operations.name: helpdesk.tickets.read
operations.summary: One ticket by its id, in the shape of a listed one, with comments: each {id, text, public, from_requester, created_at}.

operations.name: helpdesk.tickets.note
operations.summary: Add an internal note, never public, of text to the ticket id: answered {ticket, note, replayed}. The product's tool recognises a repeated request_id itself.

operations.name: helpdesk.tickets.close
operations.summary: Add the tag tag to the ticket id and set it solved, without a reply: answered {ticket, tag, previous, replayed}, previous the status before. The product's tool recognises a repeated request_id itself.
